# Wordnik

> Wordnik is a free, open-source dictionary API and comprehensive word reference platform built on crowdsourced definitions and multiple authoritative dictionary sources.

Wordnik serves as a nonprofit language resource offering word definitions, etymology, daily word features, and community-driven word adoption programs. The platform integrates data from sources like Wiktionary, WordNet, The American Heritage Dictionary, and the Collaborative International Dictionary of English, while providing APIs and language tools for developers and word enthusiasts.

- [Wordnik Homepage](https://wordnik.com): Main entry point for Wordnik's open-source dictionary API and word reference platform

- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://wordnik.com/faq): FAQ covering accounts, definitions, API, and word games troubleshooting

## Word Reference & Definitions

- [Word of the Day](https://wordnik.com/word-of-the-day): Daily word feature with definitions and etymology information
- [company - definition and meaning](https://wordnik.com/words/company): Dictionary entry for 'company' with definitions from multiple sources
- [news - definition and meaning](https://wordnik.com/words/news): Dictionary entry for 'news' with definitions from multiple sources
- [code - definition and meaning](https://wordnik.com/words/code): Dictionary entry for 'code' with definitions and semantic analysis
- [et cetera - definition and meaning](https://wordnik.com/words/et%20cetera): Dictionary entry for 'et cetera' with etymology and Latin origins
- [pleasure dome - definition and meaning](https://wordnik.com/randoml): Dictionary entry for 'pleasure dome' with alternative spellings

## Community & Word Adoption

- [Adopt a Word at Wordnik!](https://wordnik.com/adoptaword): Word adoption fundraising program supporting Wordnik's nonprofit mission
- [Wordnik: Adopted Words](https://wordnik.com/adoptedwords): Directory of community-adopted words with sponsorship information
- [Wordnik Community](https://wordnik.com/community): Community hub featuring user discussions, word lists, and neologisms
